findings.title: An initial EAGAIN retries the complete input against a changed target
findings.evidence: control_probe.py:411 only revalidates when offset is nonzero; after first-write BlockingIOError, target can disappear during select and the full payload is retried with offset zero
findings.required_correction: Revalidate target/foreground/completion before every write attempt, including retries with zero progress

findings.title: The focused fixture's general send_user path bypasses confirmed-target admission
findings.evidence: live_takeover_probe.py TakeoverSession inherits ShellProcess.send_user; after owner=user it can write while manual_prompt_confirmed is false and confirmed_target is absent, including lost-ACK state
findings.required_correction: Make the fixture's actual user-input path enforce confirmed foreground or confirmed manual prompt, and exercise that path with negative controls
